## Services & Pricing
- **Curly Hair Cut & Finish** — $175 (90 mins)
  - Customized cutting, shaping, and styling tailored to your natural wave and curl pattern.
- **Vintage Hair & Updos** — $145 (90 mins)
  - Classic victory rolls, bumper bangs, waves, and pin-up styling built for longevity.
- **Weddings, Productions & Events** — Custom Quote
  - On-location hair styling for bridal parties, commercial shoots, vintage events, and theatrical productions.
